# Ready-to-order designs

These downloads provide the sensor geometries fabricated for the paper, regenerated for the current OpenTac readout boards. Each archive contains a complete OpenTac-CAD export: KiCad layout, Gerbers, manifest, editable design, 1:1 paper template, piezoresistive-layer cutting files, and the [printed case](../build/index.md#the-printed-case) with a bottom tray and bumped, flat and hatched lids. Follow [Order the sensor](../build/order-sensor.md) for fabrication and the [assembly guide](../build/assembly.md) for construction.

The supplied layouts use two copper layers and grow mode, which allows the board boundary to expand around the routing. Open an archive in OpenTac-CAD to modify the outline, taxel size or layer count. Previews show taxels in pale blue, top-layer column traces in red, and bottom-layer row traces in blue. Select a preview to inspect it at full resolution.
